037 */
038public class CargoPods extends BaseCommandPlugin {
039        
040        public static final String TRAPPED = "$trapped";
041        public static final String LOCKED = "$locked";
042        public static final String CAN_UNLOCK = "$canUnlock";
043        
044        
045        public static final float BREAK_KEEP_FRACTION = 0.5f;
046        public static int STABILIZE_DAYS = 500;
047

050        protected SectorEntityToken entity;

055        protected CargoAPI playerCargo;
056        protected CargoAPI podsCargo;
057        protected MemoryAPI memory;

063        protected boolean isLocked() {
064                return memory.getBoolean(LOCKED);
065        }
066        protected boolean isTrapped() {
067                return memory.getBoolean(TRAPPED);
068        }
069        protected boolean canUnlock() {
070                return memory.getBoolean(CAN_UNLOCK);
071        }

073        
074        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
075                
076                this.dialog = dialog;
077                this.memoryMap = memoryMap;
078                
079                String command = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
080                if (command == null) return false;
081                
082                memory = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
083                
084                entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
085                text = dialog.getTextPanel();
086                options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
087                
088                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
089                playerCargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
090                podsCargo = entity.getCargo();
091                
092                playerFaction = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
093                entityFaction = entity.getFaction();
094                
095                plugin = (CargoPodsEntityPlugin) entity.getCustomPlugin();
096                
097                if (command.equals("printDesc")) {
098                        showDescription();
099                }
100                else if (command.equals("openCargo")) {
101                        openCargo();
102                }
103                else if (command.equals("breakLocks")) {
104                        breakLocks();
105                }
106                else if (command.equals("destroy")) {
107                        destroy();
108                }
109                else if (command.equals("stabilize")) {
110                        stabilize();
111                }
112                else if (command.equals("computeStabilizeData")) {
113                        computeStabilizeData();
114                }
115                
116                return true;
117        }
118
119        protected void computeStabilizeData() {
120                float total = podsCargo.getTotalPersonnel() + podsCargo.getSpaceUsed() + podsCargo.getFuel();
121                float stabilizeSupplies = Math.max((int) total / 200, 2);
122                
123                memory.set("$stabilizeSupplies", (int) stabilizeSupplies, 0f);
124                
125                float stabilizeDays = STABILIZE_DAYS;
126                memory.set("$stabilizeDays", (int) stabilizeDays, 0f);
127        }
128        
129        
130        public static SectorEntityToken findOrbitFocus(SectorEntityToken entity) {
131                if (entity.isInHyperspace()) return null;
132                
133                SectorEntityToken target = null;
134                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
135                List<SectorEntityToken> potential = new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>(entity.getContainingLocation().getPlanets());
136                SectorEntityToken center = ((StarSystemAPI)entity.getContainingLocation()).getCenter();
137                potential.add(center);
138                potential.addAll(entity.getContainingLocation().getJumpPoints());
139                for (SectorEntityToken curr : potential) {
140                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(entity.getLocation(), curr.getLocation());
141                        dist -= curr.getRadius();
142                        
143                        float maxDist = 400f;
144                        if ((curr instanceof PlanetAPI && ((PlanetAPI)curr).isStar()) || curr == center) {
145                                maxDist = 100000000000f;
146                        }
147                        
148                        if (dist < maxDist && dist < minDist) {
149                                target = curr;
150                                minDist = dist;
151                        }
152                }
153                return target;
154        }
155
156        public static void stabilizeOrbit(SectorEntityToken entity, boolean makeDiscovered) {
157                SectorEntityToken focus = findOrbitFocus(entity);
158                if (focus != null) {
159                        float radius = Misc.getDistance(focus.getLocation(), entity.getLocation());
160                        float orbitDays = radius / (5f + Misc.random.nextFloat() * 20f);
161                        float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegreesStrict(focus.getLocation(), entity.getLocation());
162                        entity.setCircularOrbit(focus, angle, radius, orbitDays);
163                } else {
164                        entity.getVelocity().set(0, 0);
165                }
166                
167                if (makeDiscovered) {
168                        entity.setDiscoverable(null);
169                        entity.setSensorProfile(null);
170                }
171                
172                entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$stabilized", true);
173        }
174        
175        protected void stabilize() {
176                stabilizeOrbit(entity, true);
177                
178                float stabilizeSupplies = memory.getFloat("$stabilizeSupplies");
179                float stabilizeDays = memory.getFloat("$stabilizeDays");
180                
181                playerCargo.removeSupplies(stabilizeSupplies);
182                
183                plugin.setElapsed(0);
184                plugin.setExtraDays(stabilizeDays);
185                plugin.updateBaseMaxDays();
186                
187                AddRemoveCommodity.updatePlayerMemoryQuantity(Commodities.SUPPLIES);
188                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityLossText(Commodities.SUPPLIES, (int) stabilizeSupplies, text);
189                
190                text.addParagraph("Your crew busy themselves attaching micro-thrusters and carefully " +
191                                                  "sealing, balancing, and interconnecting the pods to make sure they remain in a stable orbit.");
192//              text.addParagraph("Your crew busy themselves attaching micro-thrusters and performing " +
193//                                                "the requisite calculations to make sure the pods remain in a stable orbit.");
194                float daysLeft = plugin.getDaysLeft();
195//              String atLeastTime = Misc.getAtLeastStringForDays((int) daysLeft);
196//              text.addParagraph("When the work is done, your systems estimate they'll be able to predict the location of the pods for " + atLeastTime + ".");
197                
198                memory.set("$stabilized", true);
199                memory.set("$daysLeft", (int) daysLeft, 0f);
200                
201                
202                CargoPodsIntel intel = null;
203                for (IntelInfoPlugin iip : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(CargoPodsIntel.class)) {
204                        CargoPodsIntel curr = (CargoPodsIntel) iip;
205                        if (curr.getPods() == entity) {
206                                intel = curr;
207                                break;
208                        }
209                }
210                if (intel == null) {
211                        intel = new CargoPodsIntel(entity);
212                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(intel, true);
213                }
214                
215                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntelToTextPanel(intel, text);
216                
217        }
218        
219        protected void destabilize() {
220                if (!memory.getBoolean("$stabilized")) return;
221                
222                entity.setOrbit(null);
223                
224                Vector2f vel = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle((float) Math.random() * 360f);
225                vel.scale(5f + 10f * (float) Math.random());
226                entity.getVelocity().set(vel);
227                
228                entity.setDiscoverable(null);
229                entity.setSensorProfile(1f);
230                
231                plugin.setElapsed(0);
232                plugin.setExtraDays(0);
233                plugin.updateBaseMaxDays();
234                
235                float daysLeft = plugin.getDaysLeft();
236                String atLeastTime = Misc.getAtLeastStringForDays((int) daysLeft);
237                text.addParagraph("Working with the cargo has destabilized the orbit, but the pods should still be trackable for " + atLeastTime + ".");
238                
239                memory.unset("$stabilized");
240        }
241        
242        
243        protected void breakLocks() {
244                pruneCargo(BREAK_KEEP_FRACTION);
245                openCargo();
246        }
247        
248        
249        protected void pruneCargo(float fractionKeep) {
250                CargoAPI keep = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
251                
252                Random random = new Random();
253                if (memory.contains(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED)) {
254                        long seed = memory.getLong(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED);
255                        random = new Random(seed);
256                }
257                
258                for (CargoStackAPI stack : podsCargo.getStacksCopy()) {
259                        int qty = (int) stack.getSize();
260                        for (int i = 0; i < qty; i++) {
261                                if (random.nextFloat() < fractionKeep) {
262                                        keep.addItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), 1);
263                                }
264                        }
265                }
266                podsCargo.clear();
267                podsCargo.addAll(keep);
268        }
269        
270        
271        protected void destroy() {
272                podsCargo.clear();
273                Misc.fadeAndExpire(entity, 1f);
274        }
275
276        protected void showDescription() {
277                float daysLeft = plugin.getDaysLeft();
278                memory.set("$daysLeft", (int) daysLeft, 0f);
279                
280                boolean stabilized = memory.getBoolean("$stabilized");
281                
282                if (daysLeft >= 5000) {
283                        text.addParagraph("The cargo pods are in a stable orbit and are unlikely to drift apart any time soon.");
284                } else {
285                        String atLeastTime = Misc.getAtLeastStringForDays((int) daysLeft);
286                        if (stabilized && daysLeft > 20) {
287                                text.addParagraph("The cargo pods are in a stabilized orbit, and your systems should be able to keep track of them for " + atLeastTime + ".");
288                        } else {
289                                float depth = Misc.getAbyssalDepth(entity);
290                                if (depth >= 1f) {
291                                        text.addParagraph("This deep in abyssal hyperspace, the cargo pods are likely to be lost forever as soon as they're out of sensor range.");
292                                } else {
293                                        text.addParagraph("The cargo pods are in an unstable orbit, but should not drift apart and be lost for " + atLeastTime + ".");
294                                }
295                        }
296                }
297                
298                if (podsCargo.getTotalPersonnel() > 0) {
299                        String crewText = "Sensor readings are indicative of the presence of active life support and cryosleep equipment.";
300                        text.addParagraph(crewText);
301                }
302                
303                if (isLocked()) {
304                        if (canUnlock()) {
305                                text.addParagraph("The pods are locked, but you are in posession of the keycode.");
306                        } else {
307                                text.addParagraph("The pods are locked, and you don't have the keycode. " +
308                                                "It's possible to force the locks, but this carries a risk to the cargo. " +
309                                                "Some pods are also fitted with a self-destruct mechanism, " +
310                                                "ensuring the total loss of all cargo in the event of a breach attempt.");
311                        }
312                } else {
313                        //text.addParagraph("The pods are not locked.");
314                }
315                
316        }
317
318        public void openCargo() {
319                final CargoAPI preOpen = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
320                preOpen.addAll(podsCargo);
321                
322                dialog.getVisualPanel().showLoot("Cargo Pods", podsCargo, true, false, false, new CoreInteractionListener() {
323                        public void coreUIDismissed() {
324                                plugin.updateBaseMaxDays();
325                                
326                                if (podsCargo.isEmpty()) {
327                                        Misc.fadeAndExpire(entity, 1f);
328                                        
329                                        dialog.dismiss();
330                                        dialog.hideTextPanel();
331                                        dialog.hideVisualPanel();
332                                } else {
333                                        if (!Misc.isSameCargo(preOpen, podsCargo)) {
334                                                destabilize();
335                                        }
336                                }
337                                dialog.setPromptText("You decide to...");
338                                FireAll.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "CargoPodsOptions");
339                                FireAll.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "CargoPodsOptionsUpdate");
340                        }
341                });
342                options.clearOptions();
343                dialog.setPromptText("");
344        }
345        
346}
